text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening after training, I spotted a 
group of horse girls heading back toward 
the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your hard work today, 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone! That wraps up this 
week, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, which is why I gave it my absolute 
all! What am I gonna do if muscle soreness 
leaves me paralyzed this weekend?! 
AHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Um, do you guys have any plans for the 
weekend?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, maybe you and I could—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: UWWWWAAAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaah?! Wh-What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're really gonna ask about my weekend 
plans...?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: I have wonderful news today.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
In recognition of Winning Ticket-san 
protecting an elementary schooler from a 
traffic accident the other day, she is 
being awarded the Special Model Citizen 
Award.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAH! What an honooor!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
However, because of that incident, you 
missed the short quiz held on that day, so 
I'm terribly sorry, but you will have to 
take a makeup exam this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: UWWWWAAAAAHHH! No waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I'm the only one who has to take 
a makeup exam, waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That sounds really rough, or rather... At 
least it's an honorable makeup exam, desu 
ne...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice has some errands she needs to 
take care of too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My sister called me over this weekend. 
She's being annoying about taking me to 
buy new horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm scheduled to attend a fan exchange 
event with Fukukitaru and Bright...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've got an ultra-critical mission to show 
off my backflips to the kids at the park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My apologies as well, but I must go out 
tomorrow on Mejiro family business, desu 
wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I guess everyone's schedule is completely 
packed, desu ne...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There are certain things one can only tend 
to on days off... So, was there something 
you needed from us...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh, no! It's fine, it's nothing at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The following day, on the deserted track 
empty for the weekend off, stood a 
familiar horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright, just a quick rest and then one 
more lap... ganbaruzo!
Oh, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san!? Didn't you have a makeup test 
today...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's over now, so I came for some 
independent training! I'm finally free, 
and I feel suuuuper pumped!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's going on...? Everyone's here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice finished her errands, so I thought 
I'd go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I just gave the kids a dazzling display of 
my backflips, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I finished shopping with my sister, so I 
ended up here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So everyone finished their errands and 
came out to run—is that it, then?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Woow...! Truth is, I was actually hoping 
to do some independent training with all 
of you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For all of us to gather like this... What 
an incredible coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed, considering we all had 
completely separate plans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...However, there is something we all 
share in common.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Something in common...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That every one of us is a horse girl 
running toward her dreams, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of our dreams, we cannot 
afford to stand still... Perhaps gathering 
here for training was not a coincidence, 
but an inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...! Yes, that's so true, desu ne!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Since we're all here together, let's go 
for a run together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do a 2400m match race, just 
like the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. I was planning to train on the 
uphill slope.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Forget that! Since we got this many 
people, let's have a real race! Put on 
pedometers, do one lap around the track, 
and whoever took the most steps wins!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Everyone wants to do something 
completely different~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
While we are undoubtedly all horse girls 
chasing our dreams, our individual goals 
are quite distinct... aren't they, desu 
wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every horse girl has their own distinct 
dream. Watching them, I felt like they had 
reminded me of that fundamental truth once 
again.
